title: iris tenax subsp. chrysophylla
intro: Iris tenax subsp. chrysophylla, commonly known as the Oregon Iris, is a plant species within the genus Iris. It has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Iris tenax subsp. chrysophylla include treating wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
